description: ApexFlow is an institutional-grade platform for automated quantitative strategies, lightning-fast order execution, and real-time portfolio analytics.

services.name: High-Frequency Algorithmic Execution
services.description: Ultra-low latency connectivity to global exchanges and broker APIs with sub-millisecond dispatch.

services.name: Institutional Risk Management
services.description: Automated drawdown controls, margin monitoring, and real-time circuit breakers to safeguard capital.

services.name: AI Quantitative Backtesting
services.description: Simulate and stress-test complex multi-asset strategies across 10+ years of tick-level historical data.

services.name: Real-time Telemetry & Discord Alerts
services.description: Instant push notifications, trade fills, and PnL reporting delivered directly to your chat and mobile.

faq.question: Which brokers and exchanges are supported?
faq.answer: ApexFlow supports Kotak Neo, Interactive Brokers, Zerodha Kite, Binance, Bybit, and custom FIX protocol gateways.

faq.question: Do I need coding skills to run strategies?
faq.answer: No! You can use our pre-built quantitative strategy templates, or plug in your custom Python and PineScript algorithms.

faq.question: How secure are my broker credentials and API keys?
faq.answer: All keys are encrypted locally with AES-256 and never touch unverified external servers.
